verses: Doob ker sakhti say khenchnay walon ki qasam
Band khol ker chura denay walon ki qasam
Aur terney phirney walon ki qasam
Phir dor ker aagay barhney walon ki qasam
Phir kaam ki tadbeer kerney walon ki qasam
Jiss din kanpney wali kanpe gi
Uss kay baad aik peechay aaney wali (peechay peechay) aaye gi
(boht say) dil uss din dharakty hun gay
Jin ki nigahen neechi hun gi
Kehtay hain kay kiya hum pehli ki si halat ki taraf phir lotaye jayen gay?
Kiya uss waqt jab kay hum boseedah hadiyan ho jayen gay?
Kehtay hain kay phir to yeh lotna nuksan deh hai
(maloom hona chahaiye) woh to sirf aik (khufnak) dant hai
Kay (jiss kay zahir hotay hi) woh aik dum maidan mein jama ho jayen gay
Kiya Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki khabar tumhen phonchi hai?
Jab kay unhen unn kay rab ney pak maidan tua mein pukara
(kay) tum Firaun kay pass jao uss ney sirkashi ikhtiyar ker li hai
Uss say kaho kay kiya to apni durstagi aur islaah chahata hai
Aur yeh kay mein tujhay teray rab ki raah dikhaoon takay to (uss say) darney lagay
Pus ussay bari nishani dikhaee
To uss ney jhutlaya aur na-farmani ki
Phir palta dor dhoop kertay huye
Phir sab ko jama kerkay pukara
Tum sab ka rab mein hi hun
To (sab say buland bala) Allah ney bhi ussay aakhirat kay aur duniya kay azab mein giriftar kerliya
Be-shak uss mein uss shakhs kay liye ibrat hai jo daray
Kiya tumhara peda kerna ziyadah dushwar hai ya aasman ka? Allah Taalaa ney ussay banaya
Uss ki bulandi unchi ki phir ussay theek thaak ker diya
Ski raat ko tareek banaya aur uss kay din ko nikala
Aur uss kay baad zamin ko (humwaar) bicha diya
Uss mein say pani aur chara nikala
Aur paharon ko (mazboot) gaar diya
Yeh sab tumharay aur tumharay janwaron kay faeeday kay liye (hain)
Pus jab woh bari aafat (qayamat) aajaye gi
Jiss din kay insan apney kiye huye kaamon ko yaad keray ga
Aur (her) dekhney walay kay samney jahannum zahir ki jaye gi
To jiss (shakhs) ney sirkashi ki (hogi)
Aur dunyawi zindagi ko tarjeeh di (hogi)
Uss ka thikana jahannum hi hai
Haan jo shakhs apney rab kay samney kharay honey say darta raha hoga aur apney nafs ko khuwahish say roka hoga
To uss ka thikana jannat hi hai
Log aap say qayamat kay waqey honey ka waqt daryaft kertay hain
Aap ko uss kay biyan kerney say kiya talluq?
Uss kay ilm ki inteha to Allah ki janib hai
Aap to sirf uss say dartay rehney walon ko aagah kerney walay hain
Jiss roz yeh ussay dekh len gay to aisa maloom hoga kay sirf din ka aakhri hissa ya awwal hissa hi (duniya mein) rahey hain
